drivingQuestion: Why is a Hebrew slave's find his own if a laborer hired for general work gives his find to the employer?
outcomeNote: Three parallel resolutions of the slave/laborer objection, none rejected

segments.he: אֲבָל אָמַר לוֹ ״עֲשֵׂה עִמִּי מְלָאכָה הַיּוֹם״ – מְצִיאָתוֹ לְבַעַל הַבַּיִת.
segments.en: The baraita continues: «But» if the employer «said to» the laborer: «Work for me today,» without specifying the nature of the work, the «found item is the employer’s,» as finding ownerless items is included within the general category of work. Since a Hebrew slave is duty-bound to perform all types of labor for his master, why doesn’t his master acquire all items that he finds?

segments.he: אָמַר רַבִּי חִיָּיא בַּר אַבָּא אָמַר רַבִּי יוֹחָנָן: הָכָא בְּעֶבֶד נוֹקֵב מַרְגָּלִיּוֹת עָסְקִינַן, שֶׁאֵין רַבּוֹ רוֹצֶה לְשַׁנּוֹתוֹ לִמְלָאכָה אַחֶרֶת.
segments.en: «Rabbi Ḥiyya bar Abba said» that «Rabbi Yoḥanan said: Here we are dealing with a slave who pierces pearls [margaliyyot], which» is such a profitable activity that «his master would not want to transfer him to another» line of «work» even for a moment. Therefore his status is like that of a laborer who is hired to perform a specific task.

segments.he: רָבָא אָמַר: בְּמַגְבִּיהַּ מְצִיאָה עִם מְלַאכְתּוֹ עָסְקִינַן.
segments.en: «Rava said: We are dealing with» a case where the slave «lifts a found item» along «with» performing «his work.» Since there is no need for him to interrupt his work in order to take the item, his taking the item costs his master nothing, so it belongs to the slave.

segments.he: רַב פָּפָּא אָמַר: כְּגוֹן שֶׁשְּׂכָרוֹ לְלַקֵּט מְצִיאוֹת. וְהֵיכִי דָּמֵי? דְּאַקְּפַי אַגְמָא בִּכְווֹרֵי.
segments.en: «Rav Pappa said:» An item found by a laborer belongs to his employer only in a case «where he hired him» specifically «to collect found items.» The Gemara asks: «But what are the circumstances» in which one would hire a person to find ownerless items? The Gemara answers: It is in a case «where a lake flooded» its shore «with fish,» and after the water receded, the fish remained on the shore. One would hire laborers to gather those fish.
